one_liner: AI-powered web scraping platform with a Scraper API, a Platform API to create/rerun/manage scrapers and results, marketplace endpoints, web search, proxies, and webhooks.
access_notes: free signup yields API token; “no credit card required”
mcp_notes: published by MrScraper; hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint using OAuth 2.1, plus open-source server

evidence.quote: The MrScraper API uses API token authentication… Include your API token in the request header: x-api-token
Scraper Free includes 1,000 MrScraper tokens every month at no cost - no credit card required.
The Free plan includes 100 tokens per month with no credit card required.
Webhooks let you automatically send HTTP requests… when a scrape starts, completes, or fails.
Managed… hosted MCP endpoint… Your client follows the OAuth 2.1 challenge, opens MrScraper in your browser, and asks you to approve access.
For access to endpoints on other hosts, please contact support to request an API token.
